text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Ding-dong-dong, choo choo. When I washed 
up in this country... I was all alone.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(Yet my friends picked me up, I met my 
destined Trainer... and my journey began.)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
(A ship that started small, with few 
crewmates. Yet now—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Let's go, members of club tap dance city!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
We've made landfall at the Arima Kinen!! 
Time to show everyone who's really the 
strongest!

text_block_list.name: 500 Companions
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOHH!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A total of 500 people board about 10 
buses. Just like a high school baseball 
cheer squad. And what's more—

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Tap, you've gotta win! You're the 
strongest one out there!!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I've prayed to God so many times! 
There's no way someone who cares about 
their friends as much as you could ever 
lose!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Ah... ah... believe in me! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way in hell I'm letting you 
guys shed tears of frustration!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unlike with ordinary fans, the strength of 
their bond is different. What lies there 
is truly—an iron bond.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's go, Trainer. The strategy 
is...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, guess words are unnecessary 
between us now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to say anything. There is 
no need to give any instructions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tap Dance City and I were now completely 
of one mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Whew, there they are, they're really here! 
Just the kind of contenders worthy of the 
year-end grand naval battle!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: First—the sniper.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Royalty.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hello♪ Nice to meet you, Tap-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Savages.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Who are you talking to, you jerk?!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't get cocky, Tap. I hear you've been 
riding high lately.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one who took the bait was Jungle 
Pocket. A pint-sized bullet with a 
delinquent streak.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Don't get cocky just 'cause you gathered a 
bunch of half-assed fans and acted like 
their buddy.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
True pals are something you only become 
after going at each other full-throttle on 
the track.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hah, fellow runners, huh? That might be 
one way to look at it. But...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Not me! My friendship is way more open, 
way bigger, and totally endless!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: What? Endless, you say?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Whether someone is human or an 
Umamusume, or how many years you've known 
each other—none of that matters to me.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
If you get hung up on stuff like that, 
you'll never smash through the wall of 
reality and set sail into the wide world!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Half-assed fans? Where? Not a single one 
of my crew is like that.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, even someone I just met 
yesterday is my best buddy! That's just 
the pace I live my life at!"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Dammit, acting all high and mighty...!

text_block_list.name: 500 Companions
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: "Listen here! Can you hear this voice?"

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
The 500 people sharing my life with me, 
and the cheers of the one and only person 
to whom I entrust everything!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Try and beat me. —Try and sink me, if you 
can.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
This ship, now heading out toward the 
world! We're heading to battle!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flags bearing everyone's names fluttered 
in the sky to cheer on the captain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That was truly a cheering flag with soul. 
A one-of-a-kind flag that no millionaire 
could ever hope to buy.
